title: 第24章 狩猎蛮牛群第25章 激战
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
山谷之中，随着蛮牛的奔跑，狂风呼啸，沙土漫天。
四头身躯庞大的蛮牛宛如两座不可撼动的山岳，伫立在汪学海与钱富江面前。
汪学海与钱富江站在不远处，面色凝重地注视着被两人拦住的四头蛮牛。
蛮牛虽然只是初阶妖兽，但这巨大的体型实在太有冲击力了。
四头体型巨大的蛮牛正低声咆哮着，它们那锐利的牛角闪烁着寒光，仿佛在宣示着自己的强大。
他俩的身影在风沙中若隐若现，仿佛随时都可能被这片无垠的山脉吞噬。
汪学海深吸一口气，眼中闪过一丝坚定，之前自己没机会出手，这次绝对不能退却，随着不断的深入青风山，自己可能连出手的机会都没了。
他双手紧握长刀，开始施展裂空刀法。
他身形一闪，如鬼魅般冲向蛮牛，手中长刀挥舞，带出一片凌厉的刀光。
刹那间，裂空刀法的精髓展现无遗，裂空斩如闪电般划过虚空，带着无与伦比的威势，斩向蛮牛。
蛮牛怒吼一声，迈开粗壮的四肢，发动蛮牛冲撞，如同一辆冲锋的战车，以惊人的速度冲向汪学海。
它的牛角闪烁着寒光，仿佛要将一切都撕裂。
汪学海不慌不忙，迅速施展裂空盾，一道透明的护盾在他身前浮现。
蛮牛的冲撞撞在护盾上，发出沉闷的撞击声。
紧接着，他又使出地刺术，地面上突然冒出尖锐的地刺，刺痛了蛮牛的双脚。
蛮牛吃痛，更加愤怒地冲向汪学海，护盾开始出现裂痕。
汪学海心中一惊，立刻施展土遁术，身形消失在地面之下。
蛮牛的冲击落空，它愤怒地咆哮着，转身寻找汪学海的踪迹。
此时，汪学海从蛮牛身后破土而出，使出裂风斩。
凌厉的刀气如暴风般席卷而至，蛮牛察觉到危险，迅速发动牛角突刺，尖锐的牛角如同闪电般刺向汪学海。

一旁观战的凌啸风惊叹：“汪学海的身手越发矫健了，这裂空刀法使得真是出神入化！”
张大山也附和：“没错，面对如此凶猛的蛮牛，还能应对得如此从容，实在难得！”
汪学海侧身躲开，手中长刀不断挥舞，施展出裂空碎影。
密集的刀芒如雨点般落在蛮牛身上，溅起一串血花。
又使出裂风斩，强大的刀气直接将这头蛮牛击飞。
另一头蛮牛见状，立刻向汪学海冲来。
汪学海迅速施展轻身术，身形变得轻盈敏捷，轻松地避开了蛮牛的攻击。
他手中的长刀不断挥舞，使出裂空碎影，连续的攻击让蛮牛伤痕累累。
蛮牛愤怒地发动野蛮践踏，用力踩踏地面，产生震动波。
汪学海立刻施展空闪，快速避开震动波的攻击。
此时，蛮牛的生命力已经下降了不少，它们开始进入狂怒状态，攻击力和攻击速度大幅提升。
汪学海毫不畏惧，他使出全力，施展裂空斩，一道巨大的刀芒斩向蛮牛。
蛮牛发出痛苦的吼声，倒在地上。
解决了第一头蛮牛后，汪学海转身面对另一头蛮牛。
content_en:
In the valley, as the wild cattle ran, the wind howled and the sand filled the sky.
Four huge bulls stood like two unshakable mountains in front of Wang Xuehai and Qian Fujiang.
Wang Xuehai and Qian Fujiang stood not far away, looking solemnly at the four bulls stopped by the two.
Although the Barbarian Bull is only an entry-level monster, its huge size is too impressive.
Four huge bulls were roaring in a low voice, their sharp horns flashing with cold light, as if to declare their power.
Their figures were looming in the wind and sand, as if they might be swallowed by this boundless mountain range at any time.
Wang Xuehai took a deep breath, and a trace of determination flashed in his eyes. He had no chance to take action before, and he must not retreat this time. As he continues to go deeper into Qingfeng Mountain, he may not even have the chance to take action.
He held the long knife tightly with both hands and began to use the Sky Splitting Knife Technique.
He flashed and rushed towards the bull like a ghost, waving the long knife in his hand, bringing out a sharp sword light.
In an instant, the essence of the Sky Splitting Sword Technique was fully revealed. The Sky Splitting Slash cut through the void like lightning, slashing towards the bull with unparalleled power.
The bull roared angrily, stretched out its thick limbs, and launched the bull charge. Like a charging chariot, it rushed towards Wang Xuehai at an astonishing speed.
Its horns flashed with cold light, as if they were about to tear everything apart.
Wang Xuehai took his time and quickly used the Sky Breaking Shield, and a transparent shield appeared in front of him.
The bull's collision hit the shield, making a dull impact.
Immediately afterwards, he used the ground thorn technique again, and sharp thorns suddenly appeared on the ground, stinging the Barbarian Bull's feet.
Manniu was in pain and rushed towards Wang Xuehai even more angrily, and cracks began to appear in the shield.
Wang Xuehai was shocked and immediately used the Earth Escape Technique, and his figure disappeared under the ground.
The bull's attack failed, and it roared angrily, turning around to look for traces of Wang Xuehai.
At this time, Wang Xuehai broke out of the ground from behind Man Niu and used Splitting Wind Slash.
The sharp sword energy swept over like a storm. Sensing the danger, the bull quickly launched its horns and stabbed Wang Xuehai with its sharp horns like lightning.
Ling Xiaofeng, who was watching the battle from the sidelines, exclaimed: "Wang Xuehai's skills have become more and more powerful. This air-splitting sword technique is really amazing!"
Zhang Dashan also agreed: "Yes, it is really rare to be able to deal with such a ferocious bull so calmly!"
Wang Xuehai dodged sideways, waving the long knife in his hand continuously, displaying the Shattering Shadow.
The dense sword light fell on the bull like raindrops, splashing a bunch of blood.
Then he used the Splitting Wind Slash, and the powerful sword energy directly knocked the wild bull away.
Seeing this, the other bull immediately rushed towards Wang Xuehai.
Wang Xuehai quickly used the Light Body Technique, and his body became light and agile, easily avoiding the attack of the bull.
The long knife in his hand kept swinging, using the sky-shattering shadows, and the continuous attacks left the Barbarian Bull with scars.
The bull angrily launched a savage trample, stamping on the ground hard and generating shock waves.
Wang Xuehai immediately used air dodge to quickly avoid the shock wave attack.
At this time, the vitality of the barbarian bulls has dropped a lot, and they have begun to enter a state of rage, with their attack power and attack speed greatly increased.
Wang Xuehai was not afraid. He used all his strength to perform the air-splitting slash, and slashed at the barbarian bull with a huge sword light.
The bull roared in pain and fell to the ground.
After taking care of the first bull, Wang Xuehai turned to face the other bull.
